sources.name: Countries States Cities Database

verificationBaseline.note: Pinned comparison baseline for identity corrections; not asserted to be the unrecorded original import revision.

transformations: Field normalization and denormalized country/state labels
Compact city representation and per-country shards
Non-destructive country, subdivision, and place display-name normalization
Documented local corrections with ID migration records
Türkiye legacy city-to-district grain classification
Explicit missing, unknown, and not-applicable coverage classifications
Canonical lower-case state type enum and BCP 47 country translation keys with deprecated alias migration

sources.name: GeoNames

verificationBaseline.note: Pinned Türkiye country dump; supporting admin-code file hashes are recorded in data/sources/geonames-tr-2026-08-05.json.

transformations: Match GeoNames ADM2 identities to the reviewed current Türkiye district hierarchy
Preserve alternate GeoNames labels without replacing canonical district names
Correct the Lakshadweep District centre from the pinned GeoNames ADM2 record 9748019

sources.name: OpenStreetMap

verificationBaseline.note: Sarıçam district relation 1249247 designates node 958049062 as admin_centre.

transformations: Replace the same-named Sarıçam village point with the reviewed district admin-centre node
Replace the out-of-district Kadıköy centre with a deterministic point-on-surface from reviewed relation 1276548
Individually validate 44 small-island country assignments that are omitted or generalized by the 1:10m reference polygon

sources.name: Wikidata

verificationBaseline.note: Pinned entity revisions for Juan Fernández, Tain, and Sarupathar are recorded individually in the coordinate policy.

transformations: Correct the coordinates of Juan Fernández, Tain, and Sarupathar without changing their public identities or hierarchy

sources.name: Wikidata Query Service city QID verification

verificationBaseline.note: Batch verification of unique city QIDs for entity existence, direct instance type, country ISO code, coordinates, entity revision, and modification time.

transformations: Clear every ambiguous duplicate QID assignment
Clear missing entities and unique assignments whose Wikidata coordinate is more than 100 km away
Publish per-city verification confidence and source revision metadata

sources.name: Natural Earth Admin 1 – States, Provinces

verificationBaseline.note: Pinned 1:10m Admin-1 polygons used to generate representative points guaranteed to lie on matched subdivision geometry. Natural Earth's default de-facto worldview is treated as a QA reference, not a legal boundary authority.

transformations: Match canonical subdivisions by full ISO 3166-2-style country/state code and exact name when the code is ambiguous
Generate point-on-surface coordinates for matched polygons
Validate fallback source points against the pinned Admin-0 country reference
Retain null only as an explicit unavailable-coordinate exception

sources.name: Natural Earth Admin 0 – Countries

verificationBaseline.note: Pinned 1:10m default de-facto worldview used as the reproducible country-placement QA reference.

transformations: Classify every city point against the pinned country reference and retain worldview, dependency, territorial-claim, and scale exceptions as metadata rather than silently changing parents

sources.name: United Nations M49 Standard country or area codes

verificationBaseline.note: Reviewed terminology and region/subregion assignments for Antarctica, Bouvet Island, Côte d’Ivoire, and Heard Island and McDonald Islands.

transformations: Correct statistical region/subregion fields and official country terminology
Document country hierarchy and metadata applicability exceptions

sources.name: ISO 3166/MA, ISO 4217/MA, and European Commission country metadata verification

verificationBaseline.note: Verified assigned versus user-assigned alpha-2 code status; Bulgaria and Croatia euro adoption dates against European Commission country pages; and Mauritania MRU against ISO 4217 Amendment 165. Exact source URLs and effective dates are recorded in data/country-metadata-policy.json.

transformations: Classify 249 alpha-2 codes as officially assigned and XK as a documented user-assigned code
Update Bulgaria and Croatia to EUR and Mauritania to MRU
Publish source, verification date, code authority, and code status on every country record

sources.name: IANA Time Zone Database

verificationBaseline.note: IANA zone identifiers are authoritative. Stored offsets were calculated for 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z through the ECMA-402 Intl implementation backed by runtime tzdb 2026a; callers must calculate another instant at runtime.

transformations: Validate all 428 zoneName values as IANA time-zone identifiers
Recalculate static offsets at one explicit observedAt instant
Normalize every UTC label to UTC±HH:MM

sources.name: Institute of Statistics Albania administrative organization

verificationBaseline.note: INSTAT states that law no. 8653 dated 31 July 2000 abolished Albania's 36 districts as administrative units and identifies the 12 Qarks as the current regional administrative layer.

transformations: Classify Albania counties/Qarks as current level 1
Retain legacy district rows as historical level 2 with a validity end date instead of presenting them as current

sources.name: United States Census Bureau ANSI geographic codes

verificationBaseline.note: Reviewed the United States Minor Outlying Islands aggregate definition; an aggregate of separate islands has no single geographic centre.

transformations: Replace the invalid UM 0,0 coordinate sentinel with null and a documented reason
